core_obligations: Choose the capped-decomposition scales governed by the conjugate exponent.
Preserve both conditional co-clustering probability and diameter bounds.
difficulty_reason: The capped partition construction chooses dual-exponent scales and composes positive co-clustering probabilities under a Mazur map while controlling preimage diameter. This is a separate decomposition guarantee from Theorem1.3; the resulting spanner theorem is retained only as an uncounted consequence.
